description: Draws a new meme with AI and saves it to the caller's private library. Requires an API key and costs 500 credits per image (refunded if it fails or is refused), so search_memes first and generate only when nothing in the library fits or the user explicitly asks for a custom meme. Give a short caption and/or describe the picture; pass ref (an id from search_memes) to make a version of an existing meme's character. Refuses recognizable real people, sexual, violent or political content. The image carries a visible 'AI generated' label; it is a derivative work, not cleared for commercial use.

action.description: What the character does or looks like, e.g. 'cat slumped at a desk at 3am'

caption.description: Text drawn on the meme, up to 30 characters, in the language of the user

locale.description: Language of the label and messages; defaults to the caption's language

ref.description: id of a memecub meme whose character to reuse

style.description: panda = 熊猫头 face meme, photo, 3d, anime, sticker; omitted = chosen from the request

name: generate_meme
title: Generate a custom meme with AI
